note: The golden of the three SDKs' scene agents (scene-agents.golden.json in the TypeScript SDK, scene_agents.json here and in the Rust SDK's tests). Each refusal's words are the engine's own (CommandAGI's packages/domain/world/sim-agents.js), so an SDK and the engine refuse an agent alike. The scene holds only what the check reads: its robots' and its policies' ids.
